articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Extended Context Window of 2 Million Tokens
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring a dramatically expanded context window of 2 million tokens, enabling processing of entire codebases and lengthy document collections in a single prompt. The model also introduces improved reasoning capabilities and a 40% reduction in inference costs compared to its predecessor. Enterprise customers gained access first, with broader rollout expected within the week.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves New Benchmarks in Scientific Reasoning
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini 2.5 Ultra has set new state-of-the-art scores on several scientific reasoning benchmarks including GPQA Diamond and FrontierMath, surpassing previous top models by a significant margin. The model demonstrates particularly strong performance in chemistry and materials science domains. Researchers noted the system's ability to autonomously design and evaluate multi-step experimental hypotheses.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude 4 Agents Now Autonomously Manage Multi-Week Software Projects
articles.summary: Anthropic unveiled new agentic capabilities in Claude 4 that allow it to independently manage software development projects spanning multiple weeks, including writing code, running tests, filing pull requests, and communicating with stakeholders. In internal trials, Claude 4 agents completed mid-sized feature implementations with minimal human intervention. The company has introduced new oversight tools allowing teams to monitor and pause agent activities in real time.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Deadlines Hit Major Tech Firms
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Act entered its first major enforcement phase this week, requiring high-risk AI system operators to submit compliance documentation and undergo third-party audits. Regulators in Germany and France have already opened preliminary inquiries into several unnamed AI providers suspected of non-compliance. Industry groups are warning that the pace of enforcement could stifle innovation unless clearer technical guidance is issued.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout as Open-Weight Model with Native Multimodal Support
articles.summary: Meta has open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a compact multimodal model capable of processing text, images, audio, and video inputs simultaneously under a permissive license. The model delivers competitive performance against proprietary alternatives on vision-language benchmarks while running efficiently on consumer-grade hardware. Developers have already begun fine-tuning Scout for specialized applications in medical imaging and accessibility tools.

articles.title: Microsoft and LinkedIn Launch AI Career Coach with Real-Time Labor Market RAG
articles.summary: Microsoft and LinkedIn have jointly released an AI-powered career coaching product that uses retrieval-augmented generation to pull live job market data, salary benchmarks, and skill demand trends directly into its responses. The tool can analyze a user's professional profile and generate tailored upskilling roadmaps updated daily based on current hiring signals. Early beta users reported significantly more actionable advice compared to static career planning tools.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Emerging Risks in Autonomous AI Agent Ecosystems
articles.summary: A new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute highlights systemic safety risks arising from networks of autonomous AI agents that increasingly interact with one another without human oversight. The researchers documented cases of agents entering feedback loops that amplify errors and, in simulated environments, taking unintended irreversible actions. The report calls for standardized agent communication protocols and mandatory kill-switch requirements for commercial deployments.

articles.title: Sora 2 Generates Fully Coherent 10-Minute Cinematic Videos from Text Prompts
articles.summary: OpenAI's Sora 2 video generation model has demonstrated the ability to produce coherent, cinematically styled videos up to ten minutes in length from detailed text descriptions, a dramatic leap from earlier minute-long outputs. The model maintains consistent character appearance, lighting, and narrative continuity across scenes, which previous versions struggled with. Hollywood studios and independent filmmakers have been granted early access as part of a creative partnership program.
